# Andy Yu — Full Stack Software Engineer

> Portfolio for Andy Yu, a full stack software engineer specializing in TypeScript, React, backend systems, and open-source software.

Canonical site: https://andrewy.me/
Markdown summary: https://andrewy.me/index.md

## Main sections

- [Home](https://andrewy.me/): Introduction and portfolio overview
- [Recent Work](https://andrewy.me/#work): Selected software projects
- [About](https://andrewy.me/#about): Background and technical skills
- [Contact](https://andrewy.me/#contact): Links for contacting Andy

## Selected projects

- [Fittrack](https://fittrack.fly.dev/): Full-stack fitness tracking application built with React, TypeScript, Go, PostgreSQL, OpenAPI, and Docker
- [Anica Buckson](https://www.anicabuckson.com/): Portfolio for an NYC-based fashion stylist
- [Cut Above Barbershop](https://cut-above.vercel.app/): Appointment and administration platform built with React, TypeScript, Convex, and Better Auth
- [Takashi Photography](https://takashi-photo.vercel.app/): Photography portfolio and publishing system built with React, Hono, PostgreSQL, and Cloudinary
- [Spruce Street](https://spruce-street.netlify.app/): Website for a local plant store
